# A moth (generated by make_env.py), origin at its body.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.184 0.078 0.184 --no-slot
material new Wing --base-color 0.467 0.267 0.282 --no-slot
material new Spot --base-color 0.776 0.314 0.353 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.8 1.6 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cylinder --name WingL --vertices 5 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.03 --location -0.18 0.02 0.02
scale 1.1 0.9 1
apply --scale
material assign Wing
add mesh cylinder --name SpotL --vertices 4 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.035 --location -0.2 0.0 0.025
material assign Spot
add mesh cylinder --name WingR --vertices 5 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.03 --location 0.18 0.02 0.02
scale 1.1 0.9 1
apply --scale
material assign Wing
add mesh cylinder --name SpotR --vertices 4 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.035 --location 0.2 0.0 0.025
material assign Spot
select all
shade flat
export moth.glb
